key_findings: Electroacupuncture raised mechanical pain threshold in CSR rats and reduced spinal HMGB1, TLR4, MyD88, GFAP, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, CXCL1 and CCL2.
Analgesia is proposed to act via inhibiting astrocyte activation and the HMGB1/TLR4/MyD88 pathway.
